economic_thesis: A high-volume BTC-beta-residual impulse is tradable only after the next fully closed 8-hour residual reverses sign, evidencing absorption rather than assuming immediate mean reversion.

expected_regime_roles.bear: The confirmed positive-impulse reversal should support the short sleeve; the frozen BTC trend tilt moves five gross percentage points toward short.
expected_regime_roles.bull: The confirmed negative-impulse reversal should support the long sleeve; the frozen BTC trend tilt moves five gross percentage points toward long.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Symmetric confirmed overshoots should provide the primary combined return source.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Buy negative three-bar beta-residual impulses only after the next closed residual is positive.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Short positive three-bar beta-residual impulses only after the next closed residual is negative.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Sign confirmation is hypothesized to reject continuing shocks, but insolvency and drawdown remain immediate falsifiers rather than control triggers.

falsifier: Reject immediately for causal failure, nondeterminism, invalid execution, missing terminal evidence, or insolvency. Reject the no-control base for failure of any frozen development, fold, cost, regime, sleeve, activity or concentration gate. Only a complete base pass activates four fixed one-axis neighbors; any base or neighborhood failure makes Team 03 DNF without controls or a second pivot.
mechanism: Daily cross-sectional reversal of high-volume BTC-beta-residual impulses only after one subsequent fully closed 8-hour residual reverses sign, with past funding crowding used for ranking and a frozen slow BTC trend gross tilt.
risk_policy_plan: Use only the unchanged no-control policy. No risk-control variant is authorized; a failed base or fixed neighborhood makes Team 03 DNF.
selection_metric: Noncompensatory hard/development/fold/regime/sleeve/cost/activity gates first, then the fixed four-neighbor stability gate. Any failure ends Team 03 as DNF.
